conventions.tier: 1 = computable from the MinKNOW run folder alone; 2 = needs basecalled reads or pipeline outputs

availability.live: computable while the run is in progress, from the run folder (sample sheet, pore scan data, raw file listing)
availability.live_tmp: computable mid-run only with read access to MinKNOW's temporary sequencing summary on the acquisition host; otherwise at the end of the run
availability.end: needs files MinKNOW writes when the run ends
availability.post_basecall: needs Dorado BAMs (or a MinKNOW summary with basecalling on)
availability.post_pipeline: needs the outputs of an analysis pipeline
availability.library: needs other bundles of the FlowCellar library

verdict_role.key: can set the run or sample verdict to fail
verdict_role.supporting: can set it to warn at most

cost.small_file: kilobytes to a few MB, read whole
cost.pass_summary: one streaming pass over a large text table
cost.pass_bam: one streaming pass over a BAM (flags, lengths, tags, CIGAR)
cost.pass_bam_mm: a BAM pass that decodes MM / ML arrays; strided

thresholds.min: higher is better: pass if value >= warn; warn if fail <= value < warn; fail if value < fail
thresholds.max: lower is better: pass if value <= warn; warn if warn < value <= fail; fail if value > fail
thresholds.range: pass inside the pass band; warn inside the warn band; fail outside it
thresholds.run_config: limits are read from the run's own files (see note)
thresholds.baseline: placed against the lab's own history AS OF THE RUN'S START: robust z against the last 40 eligible runs of the comparison group that started before this run. outcome: true = the judged output of the run (warning at z <= -1.5, fail at z <= -2.5 with 8 or more comparable runs; rules, when present, are the fixed fall-back at fixed_rules_at_h hours times horizon_factors). outcome: false = an explanation: listed under a verdict at |z| >= 2, shown in the hub's 'Differs from typical' column at |z| >= 1.5, never changes the verdict of a first-use run. group_extra lists keys added to the comparison group for this metric
thresholds.rule: categorical rule spelled out in the note
thresholds.when: a rule applies when every key matches (assay, family, chemistry, model_tier, population); the first matching rule wins; no matching rule = not assessed
thresholds.fail_null: fail: null = warning level only by default; a profile may set a fail level
thresholds.baseline_replaceable: true = a judgement default that the lab's own history should replace

conventions.source_notation: seq = the acquisition whose config_summary.purpose is SEQUENCING; [k] = list index; tags are SAM tags
conventions.role_by_assay: optional: the verdict role for the named assay groups when it differs from verdict_role
conventions.section: the bundle section that stores the metric
conventions.populations: tier 2 only: the read populations (basecalled_all, basecalled_pass, classified, full_length_trimmed, aligned_primary) on which the metric's limits apply; 'any' = all. On another population the check is stored as 'not assessed: computed on <population>'
conventions.display: interface copy: label, short_label (at most 18 characters), reading (sentence under the tile or chart), how_to_read, synonyms (for 'Find a number'), message (the stored reason; the engine appends one sentence from limit_text), meaning_text and advice (shown only when the check is triggered), panel (the panel the reason links to). Written for every tier 1 key and supporting metric; null elsewhere.

metrics.formula: histogram; mode and median

metrics.meaning: The alignment cut-off pychopper tuned itself to

display.label: Cut-off pychopper chose

metrics.meaning: Share of full-length reads in which a UMI was found

display.label: Reads with a poly(A) tail found

metrics.meaning: Distribution of poly(A) tail lengths
metrics.formula: histogram of pt for pt > 0, per barcode; median, mean, p5, p95

thresholds.origin: literature (human steady-state tails have medians of roughly 50-100 nt in TAIL-seq, FLAM-seq and nanopore studies) + judgement

display.label: Poly(A) tail length
display.how_to_read: The tail length the basecaller estimated for each read, for the reads in which it found a tail. One bin per nucleotide.

metrics.meaning: Tail length by transcript type (mitochondrial and histone transcripts have short tails)

source.field: pt and reference name (GENCODE pipe-delimited) or T2G

metrics.formula: per biotype: reads, median tail
metrics.chart: box-like bar chart for the main biotypes

display.label: Poly(A) tail length by transcript type
display.how_to_read: The tail length the basecaller estimated, for the reads of each transcript type. Mitochondrial transcripts have short tails; a type whose tails are much shorter than usual may be degraded.

metrics.meaning: Share of reads that could be assigned to a known transcript
metrics.formula: mapped / processed, per sample; the tool is stored with the value

metrics.meaning: How much of its transcript each read covers

source.field: reference_start, reference_end of primary records; @SQ LN

metrics.formula: covered = (reference_end - reference_start) / transcript length; histogram, and the same split by transcript length class (< 1 kb, 1-2 kb, 2-4 kb, > 4 kb)

metrics.meaning: Share of reads that cover their transcript end to end
metrics.formula: primary records with covered >= 0.90 / primary mapped records; also for transcripts >= 3 kb

metrics.meaning: Share of reads that reach the 5' end of their transcript: falls when RNA is degraded or reverse transcription stops early
metrics.formula: primary records with reference_start <= 50 / primary mapped records

metrics.meaning: Share of reads that end at the annotated 3' end of their transcript
metrics.formula: primary records with transcript length - reference_end <= 50 / primary mapped records

metrics.meaning: Coverage along the transcript from 5' to 3'

source.field: reference_start, reference_end of primary records; @SQ LN

metrics.formula: for each read and each of 100 equal steps from the 5' end to the 3' end of its transcript, add 1 when the primary alignment covers the middle of the step; normalise by reads; one profile per transcript length class
metrics.chart: line chart, one line per length class

display.label: Coverage along the transcript body
display.how_to_read: From the 5' end (left) to the 3' end (right) of the transcript in 100 equal steps: the share of the reads that cover each step, one line per transcript length class. A line that is low at the 5' end means reads that stop before the start of their transcript; a line that falls towards the 3' end means reads that end before the end the reference gives the transcript.

metrics.meaning: Coverage near the 5' end relative to the 3' end
metrics.formula: mean coverage of bins 5-24 / mean coverage of bins 75-94, all length classes pooled
metrics.chart: annotation on the body coverage chart

metrics.meaning: How far reads extend on long transcripts

source.field: reference_start, reference_end of primary records on transcripts >= 3 kb

metrics.formula: median of (reference_end - reference_start)

metrics.meaning: Share of reads on the wrong strand of their transcript (orientation errors, antisense transcription)
metrics.formula: reverse-strand primary records / primary mapped records

display.label: Reads on the opposite strand of their transcript
display.how_to_read: Mapped reads that lie on the reverse strand of the transcript they align to. After orientation of cDNA reads, and in direct RNA, this should be close to zero.

metrics.meaning: Number of genes seen
metrics.formula: genes with >= 1, >= 10 and >= 100 reads; transcripts with >= 1 read; per sample

metrics.meaning: How many genes would have been found with less sequencing: shows whether more depth would add anything

source.field: reference name of the primary mapped records (the read count of every transcript; its gene from the transcript name where the reference gives one)

metrics.formula: expected transcripts and genes with >= 1 read, and genes with >= 10 reads, if any n of the N primary mapped reads had been sequenced: sum over transcripts (genes) of 1 - C(N - c, n) / C(N, n) from the read count c of each (hypergeometric); no reads are resampled and the order of the reads plays no part

display.label: Transcripts and genes found against reads sequenced
display.how_to_read: How many transcripts (and genes) would have been seen with fewer reads: for every depth, the expected number with at least one read if only that many of the mapped reads had been sequenced, worked out exactly from the read count of each transcript. A curve that is still rising at the right end says more reads would find more.

metrics.meaning: Share of the detected genes that came from the last tenth of the reads
metrics.formula: (G(1.0) - G(0.9)) / G(1.0) for genes with >= 10 reads

metrics.meaning: Share of reads taken by the most abundant genes: high values mean a low-complexity library

source.field: rows per gene_id (primary rows); gene_name of the top genes

metrics.formula: reads in the top 1, 10 and 100 genes / assigned reads; names of the top 10

display.label: Reads taken by the ten most abundant genes
display.how_to_read: The share of reads that the ten genes with the most reads take in one sample. A high share means few genes dominate the library.

metrics.meaning: What kinds of RNA were sequenced

source.field: quant.sf NumReads by biotype (8th field of the GENCODE target name)
transcript to biotype when names are bare ids

metrics.formula: share of assigned reads per biotype
metrics.chart: horizontal bar chart, top 8 plus other

display.label: Reads by transcript type
display.how_to_read: What kinds of RNA the reads come from, by the type of the transcript each read was given to.

metrics.meaning: Share of reads from ribosomal RNA: high values mean poly(A) selection did not work

source.field: quant.sf NumReads for biotypes rRNA, rRNA_pseudogene, Mt_rRNA
rows with transcript_type rRNA, rRNA_pseudogene or Mt_rRNA

metrics.formula: reads in rRNA biotypes / assigned reads

metrics.meaning: Share of reads from mitochondrial genes

source.field: quant.sf NumReads for genes named MT-*
idxstats chrM of the genome BAM
rows whose gene_name starts with MT-

metrics.formula: reads in MT- genes / assigned reads

metrics.meaning: Share of genome-aligned reads that cross at least one intron

source.field: CIGAR N operations of primary mapped records

metrics.formula: primary records with >= 1 N operation / primary mapped records; histogram of introns per read

metrics.meaning: Share of reads in exons, introns and between genes

metrics.meaning: Share of splice junctions in the reads that are annotated

metrics.meaning: Alignments the quantifier threw away, and why

metrics.formula: counts per reason, per sample

metrics.meaning: Share of reads from the RNA control strand (yeast enolase ENO2), if it was spiked in

control contig name (for example ENO2 / YHR174W)

metrics.formula: reads on the control contig / primary records

metrics.meaning: Accuracy measured on the control strand: independent of the sample

metrics.formula: median identity of control reads

metrics.formula: control reads covering >= 90 % of the contig / control reads

metrics.meaning: Share of adenines in DRACH motifs called as m6A

metrics.formula: pass_frac of code a
